# slideit

> Presentations whose code transitions are animated by an AST diff (GumTree). A deck is a `.slides` file (or a folder of them)
> written in KDL, plus optional assets and deck.json. It compiles to a static website, a single HTML file, a PDF or a standalone
> executable. Everything you need to write a deck is below; the full manual is in llms-full.txt (same site) and in the README:
> https://github.com/geraldserafin/md-slides

## How to produce a deck (for an LLM)

1. Make a folder `my-talk/` with one file `my-talk.slides`: a `deck` node (title, author, theme), then one `slide` node per slide.
   Put images and videos next to it.
2. Install with `npm i -g @geraldserafin/slideit` (the command is `slides`; one-off: `npx @geraldserafin/slideit ...`), check the
   file with `slides check my-talk/` (fix what it prints), then `slides dev my-talk/` (live reload) or `slides build my-talk/ -o dist`
   (static site), `--target single` (one .html), `--target pdf`, `--target exe`. A folder of deck folders becomes a chooser page.
3. Write for the audience: one idea per slide, short text, code that changes in small steps. Do not position anything: the layout of a
   slide follows from what is on it.

## The language

KDL v2: a file is a list of nodes. A node is `name "argument" key=value flag { children }`. Write children on separate lines, or on one
line separated by `;`. Text is always in quotes (`"..."`), with a little inline markup inside: `**bold**` `*italic*` `~~strike~~`
`==mark==` `H~2~O` `x^2^` `\`code\`` `[link](url)` `$tex$` `[[Key]]`; a newline is a line break. A multi-line string is
`"""` ... `"""`; a raw string `#"..."#` has no escapes (use it for code and LaTeX). `//` is a comment, `/-` before a node switches it off.
Booleans are `#true` and `#false`. Strings with `%` or spaces are quoted (`width="40%"`); bare words are flags (`video "a.mp4" loop`).

```kdl
deck title="Git branches" author="Me" theme=dark

slide {
  title "Git branches"
  text "A branch is **a movable pointer** to a commit."
  notes "Presenter notes (press p)."
}

slide {
  title "Why branches are cheap"
  list steps {
    - "a branch is 41 bytes"
    - "creating one copies nothing"
  }
}
```

| Node | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `deck` | settings of the deck (once): `title author date theme autoplay loop`; children `vars themes fonts google-fonts header footer plugins defaults animation code-style css` |
| `slide` | one slide; properties below |
| `layout "name"` | an own layout: rows and columns with `slot "name"` (and `slot` for the rest) |
| `title heading subheading text` | headings and a paragraph: `text "..."`; `size="small"\|"large"`, `align`, `valign`, `anim`, `id` |
| `list` + `- "item"` | a list (nest a `list` inside an item); flags `numbered`, `steps` (one item per click); `start=3` |
| `quote "..." by="who"` | a quote |
| `table` | `head "A" "B"` then `- "1" "2"` per row |
| `math "..."` | display math (KaTeX) |
| `code "ts" "let a = 1;"` | a block of code; several in a `swap` are the states of one animated block (below) |
| `swap { ... }` | shows one child at a time, in one place; a click brings the next; `anim=left`; a child with several things is a `col` |
| `image "a.png" alt=".."`, `video "a.mp4" autoplay loop muted nocontrols`, `audio "a.mp3"` | media, relative to the file; `width height align` |
| `chart "bar" title="T" """csv"""` | chart from CSV (first row names the series); `"bar"\|"line"\|"pie"` |
| `diagram """mermaid"""` | Mermaid diagram |
| `row` `col` `grid columns=3` | explicit layout: children side by side / stacked / in a grid; `size=2` weight, `size=auto`, `size="40%"`; `gap`, `align`, `valign` |
| `pause`, `step { ... }` | what follows / what is inside appears on the next click |
| `notes "..."` | presenter notes |

Any shown node takes `anim` (fade|rise|zoom|left|right|down|blur|pop|none) and `id=name` (morph: the same id on the next slide
glides between the two; same-file images do it automatically).

## Layouts (chosen from the content unless `layout=` says otherwise)

Only a `title` (+ `text`) on the first slide: `cover`; only a `title`: `section`; text and one image: `image-right`; several images:
`gallery`; text and animated code: `code-side`; only a `quote`: `quote`; otherwise `default`. Built in: `default cover section center quote
full two-cols three-cols image-left image-right gallery code code-side`. `two-cols` takes the slots `left` and `right`
(`slide layout=two-cols columns="1 2" { title "T"; left { text "a" }; right { code "ts" "x" } }`), `three-cols` also `middle`.
Own layout: `layout "side" { row { col size="25%" { slot "s" }; col { slot } } }` then `slide layout=side { s { text "narrow" }; text "wide" }`.

## Animated code (the point of the tool)

Several `code` nodes in a `swap` are the states of one animated block: the first is shown with the block, each next one takes a click,
and the code morphs between them (tokens glide, new ones fade in, removed ones fade out).

```kdl
slide {
  title "Total"
  swap {
    code "ts" "const total = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price, 0);"
    code "ts" focus="1" #"""
      const total = items.reduce(
        (s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
      """#
  }
}
```

A block with one state: `code "ts" "let a = 1;"`. Blocks are independent unless they share an `id`: the same `id` on another slide (or in another child
of a `swap`) continues the animation; `code from="cart"` copies the last state of the earlier block with that id. Properties of
`code` (of the first one in a swap): `id from size=18 start=10 title="cart.ts" bg="#16213e" radius=12 pad="1em" align valign fit=none` and the
flags `lines nolines nopanel`; `swap autoplay=1 loop` plays the states by itself, seconds apart, taking no clicks; each `code` of a swap
takes `focus="2-4,7"` (dim the other lines) and `transition=morph|fade|none` (how this state is entered). Languages: typescript/ts, tsx, javascript/js, python/py, rust, go, java, c, cpp, bash, json, html, css, lua.
Between two different languages the code cross-fades. A language without a grammar is a plain static block.

## Slide properties

`layout`, `columns="1 2"`, `theme=light|dark|paper|<yours>`, `background="img.jpg" | "#123" | "linear-gradient(...)" | "clip.mp4"`,
`align=left|center|right` and `valign=top|middle|bottom` (default left/top), `justify=#true`,
`transition=fade|slide|slide-right|slide-left|zoom|none`, `hidden=#true` (skip the slide), `autoplay=5`,
`header=off`, `footer=off`, `title="Short"`, `class`, any CSS variable `--accent="#f00"`.

## Plugins

`plugins "./demo.js" "@x/slideit-plugin-y"` in the `deck` node loads ES modules that default-export `{ name, tags, themes, languages, tools, hooks }`;
a plugin's nodes (e.g. `timer minutes=5`) then work like built-in ones. Authors: docs/plugins.md in the repository.

## Deck settings

```kdl
deck title="My talk" author="Me" date="2026-01-01" theme=dark autoplay=5 loop=#true {
  vars --font-heading="Georgia, serif"
  themes {
    ink --bg="#fbfaf6" --fg="#2b2e36" --heading="#11131a" --accent="#3a5ba0" --code-bg="#f1eee6"
  }
  fonts { font "Source Sans 3" src="fonts/ss3.woff2" weight="400" }
  defaults align=left justify=#true
  header left="logo.svg" right="{title}"
  footer left="My talk" right="{slide} / {slides}" height=48
  animation move=0.45 fade=0.3 transition=fade
  code-style bg=panel lines=#false radius=10 pad="0.9em 1.1em"
}
```

The same keys work as JSON in `deck.json`. Theme variables: `--bg --fg --heading --muted --accent --code-bg` and token colors
`--tok-keyword --tok-ident --tok-property --tok-type --tok-builtin --tok-comment --tok-punct --tok-plain`.

## Chooser page (a folder of decks)

`hub.json` next to the deck folders: `title`, `subtitle`, `logo`, `footer`, `links`, `theme`, `schemes`, `themes`,
`fonts`, `vars`, `css`, `align`, `cardWidth`, `show`, `order`, `colorToggle`.

## Keys while presenting

→ Space next · ← back · o slide drawer · p presenter window (notes, timer, next slide) · f fullscreen · t theme ·
l laser · d draw · z magnifier · b black screen · a autoplay · h help.
